title: Neon Plasma Armory Effects Extension
release_notes: Added an independent muzzle-flash animation for every weapon.
Added a stationary projectile sprite for every weapon; travel remains controlled by the game engine.
Added an independent impact and decay animation for every weapon.
Added dynamically detected weapon-local muzzle anchors and zero-root-motion animation metadata.

quality_holds.note: Operator reported that two impact/decay sequences resemble shrunken weapons. Identify the affected weapons and accept or replace those sequences before staging this revision.
